title: Every run on the scope
label: A radar scope where each blip is a running job drifting along its course, with a fading trail behind the turning sweep. One job, invoice-sync, starts blinking amber after three failures. An on-call cursor opens its menu and pauses it: the blip stops, its label card flips to Paused, retry at 09:42, and the sweep passes over it calmly. A countdown ring closes, the job resumes on attempt 2 and flies off the scope.
heading:
See every run.
Pause the one
that's failing.
sub: Each blip is a live execution. Pause a failing run mid-flight and it retries on schedule, with its state intact.
